summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for Multi-Region Networking; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [medium] For multi-region MongoDB Atlas clusters, you must create a private endpoint for each region that contains a node, and private endpoints are only available if a node within each spanned region has a private endpoint configured. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/troubleshoot-private-endpoints.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md

[low] For multi-region deployments using GCP port mapped endpoint services, port mapped connection strings work only when a port mapped endpoint service exists in every region where the cluster is deployed. This requirement does not apply if you have a regionalized private endpoint. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md

[low] When moving from a multi-region to a single-region cluster, you can remove old private endpoints only after verifying the cluster is fully functional in the new setup and all traffic is directed through the new single-region configuration. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md

[low] Organizations can scale seamlessly with horizontal and vertical auto-scaling, maintain low latency with multi-region clusters, and benefit from a 99.995% uptime SLA. (verified as of 2026-10-15) Sources: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-pp445qepfdy34

[low] For multi-region deployments, you can combine legacy and port mapped endpoint services to test port mapped endpoints before completing migration off legacy endpoints. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md

[low] For a multi-region cluster, the cluster's own cloud provider private link service (AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Link, or GCP Private Service Connect) must be active in every region where the cluster is deployed; otherwise the private endpoint configuration is incomplete and the SRV connection string might not resolve. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md

[low] The private endpoint connection string for a multi-region cluster uses an index of 0, and MongoDB automatically updates the connection string to use this index if a different index is provided. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/troubleshoot-private-endpoints.md

[low] If you are performing maintenance on a multi-region cluster, do not alter or remove private endpoints until maintenance is complete to avoid cluster downtime. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-private-endpoint.md
